cohort: The study included 135 postpartum patients with complete clinical documentation from two tertiary healthcare centers in Lahore, Pakistan.
finding: The study found an overall PPH occurrence of 9.6%, with maternal age 36 years or above, previous multiple pregnancies, extended labor (over 17 hours), low hemoglobin, and raised CRP identified as factors associated with a higher likelihood of PPH.
cross-section timing: Data were collected retrospectively from postpartum patients at a single point in time, focusing on their recent birth.
